svg.title: Agentic Mobility: agents, shared environment, feedback, and system dynamics
svg.desc: Traveler agents choose routes and departure times. A pricing agent adjusts congestion charges on scheduled review days. Their actions are executed in a shared mobility environment using MATSim, alongside native background trips. Personal trip outcomes and public system statistics return to the appropriate role and inform later decisions. Recorded outcomes support observation of spatial patterns and temporal change. These roles are LLM-driven with fixed model weights. Roles can be enabled separately; their appearance together depicts platform capabilities rather than a reported joint experiment.
svg.metadata: Homepage framework, simplified from the supplied mobility-loop.svg. The unchanged user-supplied agenticmobility.png is embedded, using the same Sioux Falls viewport as the earlier framework: x=677, y=194, width=842, height=527. Updated on 2026-10-19 to emphasize mobility agents, environment-mediated interaction, role-specific feedback, and observation of system dynamics. Native SVG text and shapes remain editable.

g.text: Current implementation: LLM-driven roles · MATSim execution · Fixed model weights
Traveler and pricing roles can be enabled separately.
